workflow.name: S14c_0A2 Sua bep buoi sang
workflow.description: Sửa ảnh bếp buổi sáng GỐC chọn ở 0A (ảnh chưa sửa, còn bếp gas, quạt có chữ): tải vào IMG_BEP_SANG_CU, chạy BG_B_MORNING_FIX, chọn 1 ảnh làm BG_B_MORNING (dùng ở 0B2, 0F và các file F có cảnh bếp). Bản 23/10 lần 3: giữ nguyên bếp gas và chảo gang, thùng rác đạp chân đặt cạnh tủ lạnh, sửa quạt, ảnh tủ lạnh, nóc tủ lạnh, làm bếp sáng.

nodes.prompt: Edit Image 1, a photo of an empty kitchen in the morning. Keep the same kitchen exactly: the same white cabinets, counter, double sink under the window, the old white gas range with its knobs, oven door and grates in the lower screen-right of the frame, the range hood above it, the cast-iron skillet on its back burner, the white crock of teal silicone utensils, paper towel holder, soap bottles, the old corded wall receiver, fridge, floor, camera position and framing; the range stays exactly where it is and is not removed, moved, covered or replaced. Change only these five things: 1) The paper hand fan hanging beside the wall receiver: its printed side now shows a simple painting of a small white country church under a blue sky, with no people and no words, letters or writing anywhere on the fan. 2) The snapshots on the fridge door: replace every photo with snapshots of one Black American family, only adults: an older Black woman with short silver hair smiling with two church friends, a Black man in his forties with a salt-and-pepper beard beside his wife, and a young Black woman with long braids in a graduation cap; every person in every photo is Black American; keep the same number of photos, the same sizes, magnets and places, small and a little soft; the paper notes on the fridge are blank. 3) Remove the cereal boxes and everything else from the top of the fridge. 4) Add a white plastic step trash can, about knee height, with a hinged lid and a small foot pedal clearly visible at its bottom front, standing on the floor in front of the lower cabinets near the fridge, in the lower screen-left part of the frame, lit like everything around it, with a soft contact shadow on the floor; it does not cover or replace anything. 5) The light: a bright, fresh early morning. Clear sunlight comes in through the window over the sink and falls across the counter, and soft daylight bounces around the whole room, so the upper and lower cabinets, the fridge and the floor are clearly lit, with gentle open shadows and nothing dark or gloomy in the corners. The white cabinets, the range and the fridge look clean, true white, not grey or green; the walls a soft warm cream; only the shadows keep a slight cool morning freshness. The window is bright but keeps its frame and a soft view outside. The old kitchen looks well kept and cared for. Looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors; no over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same kitchen as Image 1, with the old white gas range and its skillet still in the lower screen-right; only the fan picture, the fridge photos, the top of the fridge, the new trash can by the fridge and the brighter light changed.
